messages:
jules: Quick sync: customers keep asking who actually executed a request when we see a proxy in the path. Console shows the caller project and it's misleading.
anita: Is this affecting quota enforcement or just observability/dashboarding?
jules: Enforcement is unchanged (billing project still charged) but our dashboards, alerts, and per-route cost breakdowns attribute to the incoming key. That breaks oncall triage.
kevin: We should add an immutable audit attribute for the final execution principal (service account) and expose it in traces & optional metrics.
lena: Agreed. Implementation suggestion: have auth-proxy emit a sealed header `X-RW-EXEC-PRINCIPAL` with the final SA identity, while keeping `X-RW-ORIGIN-PROJECT` for the incoming key. Runtime will plumb both into traces.
jules: Example header: `X-RW-EXEC-PRINCIPAL: sa:projects/prod-123/serviceAccounts/inference@proj.iam.gserviceaccount.com`
anita: Important privacy constraint: do not leak cross-org SA names to users without access. Console should show a link only when the viewer has view-permission on that project; otherwise show "service account (restricted)".
kevin: Telemetry plan: attach `exec_principal` as an optional metric dimension `rw.requests.count{origin_project, exec_principal?, model, route}`. But watch cardinality: many orgs create ephemeral SAs.
lena: Cardinality mitigation: three options: 1) index top-N principals per org and bucket rest as `sa:other`, 2) sample 1% of exec_principal-tagged requests for high-churn orgs, or 3) keep exec_principal only on traces (no metric tag) and derive top principals via batch jobs. Which one balances cost vs UX?
jules: I prefer option 1 for immediate usefulness (top-N gives customers useful links) combined with option 3 as fallback for deep forensics.
anita: Also add `impersonation_chain_len` as a small int metric so we can detect chained proxies without exposing names.
kevin: Security note: header must be set only by trusted proxies. Use mTLS + header HMAC stamped by proxy private key. Reject requests that attempt to set the header externally.
lena: Operationally: rollout steps I propose:
  1) proxy emits `X-RW-EXEC-PRINCIPAL` behind internal flag for telemetry only (no UI) for 72h,
  2) run a 30d uniqueness sample to estimate exec_principal cardinality per org,
  3) if safe, enable a console column behind feature flag with privacy gating and top-N aggregation,
  4) make alerts by exec_principal opt-in for teams that want it.
kevin: Backfill: when traces contain the exec header we'll run a read-only reconciliation to annotate recent traces/dashboards. Ensure billing ETL ignores the new dimension unless explicitly toggled.
anita: UX idea: add a switch in the usage dashboard "Group by -> origin / executor" and show a short explanation: "Executor groups may be aggregated to protect privacy and control cost."
jules: Also expose a small debug link "Show sampled chains" that opens an audit view for authorized users showing full impersonation chain (only sampled, with retention shorter than normal traces).
lena: Compliance/legal: retention of exec principal identifiers may require shorter retention for PII-sensitive orgs. Add a per-org retention override to the metering pipeline.
kevin: Metric storage cost estimate: I'll run a job to sample last 30d request logs and return expected unique exec_principal counts per org by EOD. We'll include a projected ingested metric cardinality and cost.
ops-bot: Note: create RFC ticket `exec-principal-telemetry-and-console` and include cardinality numbers, security design, and UI mocks.
jules: Action items: Kevin runs cardinality sample; Lena drafts UI mock + privacy copy; Anita drafts RFC and rollout timeline; I'll open the proxy PR emitting header behind flag.
anita: One more: when proxy chains occur we will store only the final principal in metrics but keep a sampled chained trace for auditing with `chain_len` and a sampled `chain_log` blob for postmortem.
kevin: I'll ensure header HMAC and proxy certificate validation are in the PR. If anything spikes in alerts during the probe window, we'll revert and page #eng-oncall.
lena: I'll mock the "restricted" badge tooltip text: "This executor is hidden because you don't have access to its project. Request access or contact the owner."
jules: Thanks team. Aim to flip internal flag Monday and collect 72 hours of telemetry. I'll post the RFC link once Anita has the draft. :thumbsup:
